subject: maths
question: The breadth ‘b’ of a room is twice its height and half of its length. Find the length of the longest diagonal of the room.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Express all dimensions in terms of breadth 'b':

Given: Height (h) = b/2 and Length (l) = 2b.

Formula for longest diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).

Diagonal = √((2b)² + b² + (b/2)²) = √(4b² + b² + b²/4) = √(21b²/4).

**∴ The correct answer is (√21 b) / 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb774f8012acf69f6a6291f4e0afa16e6768b5d17942276d76fe4ce120ee2718.png] 

**Given:**

Breadth = b

Breadth is twice the height ⇒ b = 2h ⇒ h = b/2

Breadth is half of the length ⇒ b = l/2 ⇒ l = 2b

**Formula Used:**

Longest diagonal of a room (cuboid) = √(l² + b² + h²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Diagonal = √((2b)² + b² + (b/2)²)

⇒ Diagonal = √(4b² + b² + b²/4)

⇒ Diagonal = √(5b² + b²/4)

⇒ Diagonal = √((20b² + b²)/4)

⇒ Diagonal = √(21b²/4)

⇒ Diagonal = (√21 b) / 2

**∴ The correct answer is (√21 b) / 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

The sum of the areas of all 6 faces is given by the formula 2(lb + bh + hl).

Volume of a Cuboid

The total space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Length × Breadth × Height.

Diagonal of a Cube

If all sides are equal (l = b = h = a), the longest diagonal is simplified to √3 a.

Area of Four Walls

The lateral surface area of a room is calculated as 2(l + b) × h.</p
